title: Ijwi Ryafatanije n'Imisozi .
intro: Umutima ugororotse warahawe ingabirano zidasanzwe zivuye mw’ijuru, ukaba umutware n’umurwanyi kamere yiwe nyene yasa n’iyifatanye n’ivyaremwe ubwavyo. Inkuru yabo iraboha mu buhanuzi, mu bwami no mu buhinga, igasiga iragi risubiramwo mu mapaji y’ivyahishuriwe n’Imana.
clues: Natowe kuba umusavyi wa Allah, mpabwa ubwami bukomeye mu bantu batoranijwe.
Imisozi n’inyoni vyari kuvugana nanje mu kuninahaza Isumba vyose.
Ivyuma vyacitse nk’ibumba mu minwe yanje, ku bushake bwa Allah wenyene.
Narakora ibirwanisho vy’uburinzi vyakingira abarwanyi mu gihe c’ubushuhe bw’intambara.
Igihe kimwe naratsinze ikigeragezo kigoye igihe abantu babiri bariko baratongana binjira aho nsenga ata co niteze.
Ndavugwa iruhande y’umutware yategetse umuyaga n’amajini — kuko uwo mutware yari uruvyaro rwanje bwite.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
